correctness.rationale: The normalized B_n root set has 2n² points in antipodal pairs; addition kernel is p_{n,l}(x·y) with p_n,l normalized at 1. Coordinate sign characters split the sample module, and Gegenbauer parity annihilates one n²-dimensional half. Odd surviving singleton-character blocks yield scalar 2−4v and 2x2 T_o eigenvalues; even surviving two-character blocks yield scalar 2(1−u), while trivial sign character block is decomposed using unsigned complete-graph incidence MM^T=(n−2)I+J into ker M scalar, n−1 standard T_s blocks, and constant T_c. Dimensions sum to 2n². Symbolic n-dependent Gegenbauer evaluations show degree5 all compatible branches positive and degree6 exactly one zero in T_c; independent direct full Gram numerical spectra checked n=3..6, l=0..8, with max discrepancy 4.5e−14. Universal result rests on representation/incidence decomposition and symbolic determinants.
residual_risks: These are exact single-degree, unweighted root-sample Gram matrices; not bandlimited or long-root-only.
Finite spectral comparisons are not substitute for all-n character-block proof.
